title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → Employee / Worker
architecture_notes: PeopleSoft HCM stores employee data across PS_JOB (the master employment record, effective-dated with ACTION/ACTION_REASON), PS_PERSONAL_DATA (person identity), PS_EMPLOYMENT (hire/termination dates), and PS_NAMES/PS_ADDRESSES/PS_EMAIL_ADDRESSES (contact info). Every change to an employee's job is an effective-dated row in PS_JOB with an ACTION code (HIR=hire, PRO=promotion, XFR=transfer, TER=termination, DTA=data change, etc.). EMPLID is the universal person key.

source_objects.description: Master employment record: EMPLID, EMPL_RCD, EFFDT, EFFSEQ, ACTION, ACTION_REASON, DEPTID, JOBCODE, POSITION_NBR, LOCATION, COMPANY, EMPL_STATUS (A=active, T=terminated, L=leave, S=suspended, R=retired, D=deceased), REG_TEMP (R=regular, T=temp), FULL_PART_TIME (F/P), FTE, STD_HOURS, FLSA_STATUS (E=exempt, N=non-exempt), SAL_ADMIN_PLAN, GRADE, STEP, REPORTS_TO, UNION_CD, EMPL_CLASS. Effective-dated — multiple rows per employee.

Person identity: EMPLID, NAME, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME, NAME_PREFIX, NAME_SUFFIX, SEX (M/F/U/O), BIRTHDATE, MAR_STATUS, NID_COUNTRY + NATIONAL_ID (SSN for US), CITIZENSHIP_STATUS, ETHNIC_GRP_CD.
Employment dates: EMPLID, EMPL_RCD, HIRE_DT, REHIRE_DT, TERMINATION_DT, LAST_DATE_WORKED, CMPNY_SENIORITY_DT (continuous service date), ORIG_HIRE_DT.
Name history (effective-dated): EMPLID, NAME_TYPE (PRI=primary, PRF=preferred), EFFDT, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME.
Addresses: EMPLID, ADDRESS_TYPE (HOME, MAIL, BUS), EFFDT, ADDRESS1-4, CITY, STATE, POSTAL, COUNTRY.
Email: EMPLID, E_ADDR_TYPE (BUS=business, HOME=home, CAMP=campus), EMAIL_ADDR, PREF_EMAIL_FLAG.
Phone: EMPLID, PHONE_TYPE (MAIN, BUSN, HOME, CELL), PHONE.
National ID: EMPLID, NATIONAL_ID, NID_TYPE (PR=SSN). Restricted.
Ethnicity code decode: ETHNIC_GRP_CD, DESCR. IPEDS/EEO categories.
Action code decode: ACTION, DESCR. HIR, REH, PRO, XFR, TER, DTA, LOA, RFL, RET, etc.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. EMPLID is the universal PS person key (shared with Student in CS).
Resolve to HELIX person_id. Same EMPLID may appear in CS (as a student) and HCM (as an employee).
Falls back to PRI if no PRF row.
Map to HELIX ethnicity terminology. IPEDS/EEO categories.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_JOB.EMPL_CLASS or derived from JOBCODE + DEPTID

notes: PS_JOB is effective-dated with ACTION/EFFSEQ. Always get the current row: max EFFDT ≤ today, max EFFSEQ within that EFFDT. EMPL_RCD handles concurrent jobs (0=primary, 1+=additional). The ACTION field on every row tells you WHY it exists (HIR, PRO, XFR, TER, DTA, PAY, etc.) — this is critical for reconstruction of employment history. EMPLID is shared between CS and HCM, so the same person may be both a student and an employee.
